name: Seker
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Seker was a son of Ephraim, the son of Joseph. He is mentioned in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles as part of Ephraim's descendants. His family was struck by tragedy when some of his brothers were killed by men from Gath.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Shecer is recorded as one of the sons of Ephraim in the genealogies of 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Shecer belonged to the tribe of Ephraim, which was one of the twelve tribes of Israel and received a significant portion of the promised land.

keyEvents.title: The Tragedy in Ephraim's Family
keyEvents.description: Some of Ephraim's sons, including Ezer and Elead, were killed by the men of Gath when they tried to seize their livestock. Ephraim mourned for them for a long time.

keyEvents.title: Ephraim's Blessing from Jacob
keyEvents.description: Ephraim, Shecer's father, was blessed by his grandfather Jacob, who placed him above his older brother Manasseh, securing a prominent position for his descendants.
